All praise belongs to Allah, who sent down the Book to His servant and made it with nothing crooked in it.
It is straight and clear. It warns of a hard punishment from Him, and gives good news to believers who do good: they will have a fine reward.
They will stay in it forever.
And it warns the people who say: Allah has a son.
They have no knowledge of this, and neither did their fathers. What a big thing to say! They say nothing but a lie.
Maybe you will make yourself sick with sadness over them, if they do not believe this message.
We made what is on the earth a decoration for it, to test them: which of them does the best.
And We will make everything on it like bare dust.
The People of the Cave and the Inscription were one of Our amazing signs.
When the young men went to the cave, they said: Our Lord, give us kindness from You and make our way right.
Then We made them sleep in the cave for many years.
Then We woke them up to see which of the two groups could count better how long they stayed.
We tell you their story truly. They were young men who believed in their Lord, and We gave them more guidance.
And We made their hearts strong when they stood up and said: Our Lord is the Lord of the sky and the earth. We will never call on any god but Him. If we did, we would be saying something very wrong.
These people of ours have taken other gods besides Him. Why do they not bring a clear proof? Who does more wrong than the one who makes up lies about Allah?
Now you have left them and what they worship besides Allah. Go to the cave. Your Lord will spread His kindness over you and make your matter easy.

You would see the sun rise and move away from their cave to the right, and when it sets, pass them on the left, while they lie in the wide part of the cave. That is one of Allah's signs. Whoever Allah guides is guided, and whoever He lets go astray, you will find no helper for him.

You would think they were awake, but they were asleep. We turned them over to the right and to the left, and their dog stretched out its paws at the door. If you saw them, you would turn and run away, full of fear.

In the same way, We woke them up so they could ask each other. One of them said: How long did you stay? They said: We stayed a day or part of a day. They said: Your Lord knows best how long you stayed. Send one of you to the city with this silver coin. Let him look for the best food and bring you some. Let him be gentle and not let anyone know about you.
If they find out about you, they will throw stones at you or force you back to their religion. Then you will never win.

In the same way, We let people find them, so they would know that Allah's promise is true and that the Hour will surely come. They argued about them. Some said: Build a building over them. Their Lord knows best about them. The ones who won the argument said: We will build a place of prayer over them.

Some will say: They were three, and the fourth was their dog. Some will say: Five, and the sixth was their dog. They are only guessing. Some will say: Seven, and the eighth was their dog. Say: My Lord knows best how many they were. Only a few know. So do not argue about them except in a simple way, and do not ask anyone about them.
Never say about anything: I will do that tomorrow.
Without saying: If Allah wills. And remember your Lord when you forget, and say: Maybe my Lord will guide me to something even closer to the right way than this.
And they stayed in their cave for three hundred years, and nine more.
Say: Allah knows best how long they stayed. He knows what is hidden in the sky and the earth. How well He sees and hears! They have no protector besides Him, and He shares His rule with no one.
And read what was sent to you from the Book of your Lord. No one can change His words. And you will find no safe place except with Him.

And keep yourself with those who call on their Lord morning and evening, wanting His face. Do not let your eyes turn away from them, looking for the shine of this world. And do not obey the one whose heart We made forget Us, who follows his own wants, and whose matter is lost.

Say: The truth is from your Lord. Whoever wants to, let him believe. And whoever wants to, let him say no. We made ready for the wrongdoers a Fire whose walls will close around them. When they cry for water, they will be given water like melted metal, which burns the faces. What a terrible drink and what a terrible place to rest!
As for those who believe and do good, We never waste the reward of anyone who does good work.

For them are the Gardens of Eden with rivers flowing below. They will wear gold bracelets and green clothes of silk and rich cloth, resting on soft couches. What a great reward and what a lovely place to rest!
Tell them the story of two men. To one of them We gave two gardens of grapes, with date trees all around them and crops between them.
Both gardens gave their fruit in full and did not fail at all. And We made a river flow between them.
And he had lots of fruit. He said to his friend as they talked: I have more money than you, and more people with me.
And he went into his garden, wronging himself. He said: I do not think this will ever be destroyed.
And I do not think the Hour will come. And even if I am sent back to my Lord, I will find something better than this.
His friend said to him as they talked: Do you say no to the One who made you from dust, then from a drop, then shaped you into a man?
But as for me, He is Allah, my Lord, and I never put anyone beside my Lord.
When you went into your garden, why did you not say: What Allah wants! There is no power except with Allah? Even if you see me with less money and children than you.
Maybe my Lord will give me something better than your garden, and send a storm from the sky on yours, so it becomes bare ground.
Or its water will sink into the ground, so you cannot find it.
And his fruit was ruined. He began wringing his hands over what he spent on it, as it lay fallen on its frames. He said: I wish I had never put anyone beside my Lord!
He had no group to help him other than Allah, and he could not help himself.
That is because all help belongs to Allah, the True. He is the Best in rewarding and the Best in the end.
Give them an example of this life: It is like water We send down from the sky. The plants of the earth mix with it, then it becomes dry bits that the wind blows away. Allah has power over everything.
Money and children are the decoration of this life. But the good things that last are better with your Lord, for reward and for hope.
On the Day when We move the mountains and you see the earth wide open, and We gather them all and leave no one behind.
They will be shown before your Lord in rows: You came to Us as We made you the first time. But you thought We would not set a meeting for you.

And the book will be put down. You will see the people who did wrong afraid of what is in it. They will say: How terrible for us! What is this book that leaves out nothing, small or big, but counts it? They will find everything they did right there. And your Lord does not wrong anyone.

We said to the angels: Bow down to Adam. They bowed down, except Iblis. He was one of the jinn, and he did not obey the order of his Lord. Will you take him and his children as your helpers instead of Me, when they are your enemies? What a bad trade for the wrongdoers!
I did not make them witness the making of the sky and the earth, or even their own making. And I do not take those who lead people astray as helpers.
On the Day when He will say: Call My partners that you claimed. They will call them, but they will not answer them. And We will put a wall between them.
And the people who did wrong will see the Fire and know they will fall into it. They will find no way away from it.
We have given in this Quran every kind of example for people. But man argues more than anything.

What stopped people from believing when the guidance came to them, and from asking their Lord to forgive them? Only waiting for what happened to the people before them, or for the punishment to come to them face to face.
We only send messengers to give good news and to warn. But people who say no argue with false words to defeat the truth. They take My verses and the warnings as a joke.

Who does more wrong than the one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord and turns away from them, and forgets what his hands sent ahead? We put covers on their hearts so they do not understand it, and heaviness in their ears. Even if you call them to the right way, they will never follow it.
Your Lord is the Forgiving, full of kindness. If He were to take them for what they earned, He would hurry the punishment for them. But they have a set time, and they will find no way to escape it.
And these towns: We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We set a time for their end.
Remember when Musa said to his young helper: I will not stop until I reach the place where the two seas meet, even if I walk for years.
When they reached the place where the two seas meet, they forgot their fish. It found its way into the sea and swam away.
When they went further, he said to his helper: Bring us our lunch. We are tired from this trip.
He said: Do you remember when we rested by the rock? I forgot the fish. Only Shaytan made me forget to tell you. It found its way into the sea in an amazing way.
Musa said: That is what we were looking for! So they went back, following their steps.
Then they found one of Our servants, whom We had given kindness from Us and had taught knowledge from Us.
Musa said to him: May I follow you so you can teach me some of the right guidance you were taught?
He said: You will not be able to be patient with me.
And how can you be patient with something you do not know about?
Musa said: You will find me patient, if Allah wills, and I will not disobey you in any order.
He said: If you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I tell you about it myself.
So they went. Then when they got on the boat, he made a hole in it. Musa said: Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have done a terrible thing.
He said: Did I not tell you that you will not be able to be patient with me?
Musa said: Do not blame me for forgetting, and do not make it too hard for me.
So they went. Then when they met a boy, he killed him. Musa said: Did you kill an innocent person who did not kill anyone? You have done a very bad thing.
He said: Did I not tell you that you will not be able to be patient with me?
Musa said: If I ask you about anything after this, do not stay with me. You have had excuses from me.

So they went. Then when they came to the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to host them. There they found a wall that was about to fall, and he fixed it. Musa said: If you wanted, you could have taken pay for it.
He said: This is where you and I part. I will tell you the meaning of what you could not be patient about.
As for the boat, it belonged to poor people who worked at sea. I wanted to damage it because a king was coming after them who took every good boat by force.
As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared he would trouble them with wrong and with saying no to Allah.
So we wanted their Lord to give them in his place a better child, who was cleaner and closer in kindness.

As for the wall, it belonged to two boys in the town who had no father. Under it was a treasure for them. Their father was a good man. Your Lord wanted them to reach their strength and take out their treasure, as a kindness from your Lord. I did not do it on my own. This is the meaning of what you could not be patient about.
They ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say: I will tell you something about him.
We gave him power on the earth, and gave him a way to do all things.
He followed a way.
Until he reached the place where the sun sets. He found it setting in a spring of dark water, and found a people near it. We said: O Dhul-Qarnayn, you can punish them, or you can be kind to them.
He said: As for the one who does wrong, we will punish him. Then he will go back to his Lord, who will punish him with a punishment he has never known.
But as for the one who believes and does good, he will have the best reward, and we will speak to him with easy words.
Then he followed another way.
Until he reached the place where the sun rises. He found it rising on a people who had no cover from it.
And so it was. We knew all that he had.
Then he followed another way.
Until he reached the place between the two mountains. He found next to them a people who could hardly understand what was said.
They said: O Dhul-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are making trouble in the land. Can we pay you to build a wall between us and them?
He said: What my Lord gave me is better. But help me with your strength, and I will build a wall between you and them.
Bring me pieces of iron. When he had filled the space between the two mountain sides, he said: Blow! When he made it like fire, he said: Bring me melted metal to pour on it.
So they could not climb over it, and they could not dig through it.
He said: This is kindness from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it flat. The promise of my Lord is always true.
On that Day We will leave them pushing against each other like waves. And the horn will be blown and We will gather them all together.
On that Day We will show Hell to those who said no, all of them.
Those whose eyes were covered from My reminder, and who could not hear.
Do the people who said no think they can take My servants as helpers instead of Me? We have made Hell ready as a welcome for those who say no.
Say: Should We tell you who loses the most in what they do?
Those whose effort in this life was lost, while they thought they were doing good work.
They are the ones who said no to the verses of their Lord and to meeting Him. So their work is lost. And on the Day of Judgment We will give them no weight.
That is their payment: Hell, because they said no, and because they made fun of My verses and My messengers.
As for those who believe and do good, they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a welcome.
They will stay there forever, and will not want to move from it.
Say: If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were finished, even if We brought another sea like it to add.
Say: I am only a human like you. It is shown to me that your God is One God. Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him do good, and not put anyone beside his Lord in worship.
